text:
sarah: Quick follow-up from last week's authz incident — we identified two correlated issues: an audit-log gap for /validate and token TTLs not honouring rotation windows. Need concrete owners and timelines.

mike: I'll take the audit-log gap. first pass: check fluentd->elk pipeline and retention/ingest lags.

tam: assigning token TTLs to me. will audit the rotation job, KMS key policy and any manual overrides.

ops-bot: artifacts uploaded: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/authz-incident-2026-03-18.zip (logs, prometheus snapshots, sysdig traces)

julia: FYI i've seen a recurring pattern: similar gap on /validate back on 2026-02-21. Logging config drift + delayed shipper restarts. worth adding to recurring-incident tracker.

sarah: action items (initial):
- mike: validate why log entries missing for /validate between 03:10-03:25 UTC and confirm if they were dropped at source or during shipping. (ETA: EOD tomorrow)
- tam: confirm token rotation job ran, check token-ttl overrides in service config, reconcile with KMS key rotation timeline. (ETA: Fri COB)
- kevin: run a small canary deployment of rotation changes on staging and validate metric delta for token expiration events. (ETA: Sat morning)
- sarah: update authz runbook with verification steps and add a pre-rotation audit checklist. (ETA: next Tue)

mike: initial findings — fluentd had a backpressure spike; two workers dropped connection to the aggregator during that window. config snippet:
```
# fluentd buffer config
<buffer tag>
  @type file
  flush_interval 1s
  chunk_limit_size 8m
</buffer>
```
I'll instrument a metric to alert on buffer retries.

tam: rotation job looked like it executed, but one microservice has a stale override: `SERVICE_TOKEN_TTL=90d` in k8s secret for validator-service. that explains the longer TTLs. I'll remove override and trigger redeploy.

kevin: scheduling staging canary now. also proposing to add an automated post_rotation_audit job that checks for unexpected TTLs across secrets.

julia: adding this thread to the recurring-incident tracker and creating a followup ticket to evaluate long-term mitigations (shipper HA, rotation verification pipeline).

sarah: good. small follow-up: mike, please create a short doc of the fluentd hardening steps you suggest. tam, please attach the exact manifests you update. i'll coordinate the rollback/fix windows with infra.

mike: noted — doc and PR by tomorrow morning.

tam: manifest PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/validator-service/pull/412 (includes secret update and rollout plan).

sarah: we'll sync in the incident-aftercare slot tomorrow 09:30 PT to confirm closure criteria. thanks all. :thumbsup:

julia: :thumbsup:
